questions.question: In which month did the United States record its peak monthly count of deaths with COVID-19 as the underlying cause?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_monthly_deaths_select_causes_2020_2023.csv')
top_row = df.loc[df['COVID-19 (Underlying Cause of Death)'].idxmax()]
result = f"{int(top_row['Year'])}-{int(top_row['Month']):02d}"

questions.question: How many total deaths from heart disease were recorded in the United States during the full year of 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_monthly_deaths_select_causes_2020_2023.csv')
result = int(df[df['Year'] == 2020]['Diseases of Heart'].sum())

questions.question: Did all-cause mortality in the United States top 300,000 in any single month during 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_monthly_deaths_select_causes_2020_2023.csv')
result = 'yes' if (df[df['Year'] == 2022]['All Cause'] > 300000).any() else 'no'

questions.question: Across all of 2021, how many more deaths had COVID-19 listed as a multiple cause compared to those where it was the underlying cause?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_monthly_deaths_select_causes_2020_2023.csv')
df_2021 = df[df['Year'] == 2021]
result = int(df_2021['COVID-19 (Multiple Cause of Death)'].sum() - df_2021['COVID-19 (Underlying Cause of Death)'].sum())

questions.question: In how many months of 2021 did unintentional injury deaths exceed 19,000?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_monthly_deaths_select_causes_2020_2023.csv')
result = int(((df['Year'] == 2021) & (df['Accidents (Unintentional Injuries)'] > 19000)).sum())

questions.question: What was the monthly average number of Alzheimer's disease deaths in 2020, rounded to the nearest whole number?
questions.program:
